# Fixture Academy: tutoring policy

A tiny academy whose export has records only: no question text, no errors and no hints. History, practice and staff notes follow the same rules as the synthetic academies' policies.

## In numbers

| Setting | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Practice questions after a wrong answer | 2 |
| Practice difficulty, lowest percent correct | 40 |
| Practice difficulty, highest percent correct | 70 |
| History window, latest attempts on the topic | 3 |
| Wrong answers that call for a staff note | 2 |
| Days those wrong answers are counted over | 14 |
| Attempts that count in history | every attempt |
| First hint | the general hint |
